How do City of Delta Flood Construction Levels (FCL) apply to new custom homes?

New residential builds in Ladner must meet City of Delta Flood Construction Level elevation bylaws and site-specific geotechnical preload/engineered fill requirements so habitable living areas sit safely above designated floodplain levels.
Are float homes and waterfront properties in Ladner freehold or leasehold?

Upland houses along River Road West sit on freehold title (sometimes paired with a provincial water-lot lease for a private dock), whereas float homes moored in Ladner Harbour marinas typically occupy a monthly or multi-year moorage licence/lease rather than fee-simple land title, which affects mortgage financing.
What are the ALC house size rules on Ladner Rural and East Delta farmland?

On Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) parcels in Delta, Agricultural Land Commission regulations cap the principal residence at 500 m² (5,382 sq ft) of total floor area and permit a secondary dwelling up to 90 m² (969 sq ft) subject to municipal zoning and flood-level permits.
How is BC Property Transfer Tax calculated on Ladner homes over $2M?

BC Property Transfer Tax is calculated at 1% on the first $200,000, 2% on the portion between $200,000 and $2,000,000, 3% on the portion between $2,000,000 and $3,000,000, and 5% on the residential value above $3,000,000.
Do newer custom homes in Ladner include legal secondary suites?
Yes. Nearly all recent custom single-family builds in Hawthorne, Holly, Delta Manor, and Port Guichon are designed with a self-contained ground-level 1- or 2-bedroom registered secondary suite.
